capabilities.name: seed
capabilities.reason: Create specs, plans, and execution briefs suitable for ooo auto.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record decisions, verification evidence, command outcomes, and blocked states.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist multi-step invocation state and handoff artifacts.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record upstream repository, commit, skill path, license, and invocation context.

capabilities.name: runtime
capabilities.reason: Prepare bounded runtime execution handoffs; direct execution remains permission-gated.

capabilities.name: mcp
capabilities.reason: Represent browser/devtools and future MCP-backed skills without implicit authority.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach structured outputs for ooo auto or future Workflow IR consumers.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report phase progress and readiness during multi-step workflows.

permissions.reason: Inspect repository files, diffs, docs, tests, and local upstream checkouts.
Write structured handoff, provenance, audit-compatible, spec, plan, ADR, and verification artifacts.
Optionally run tests, builds, linters, formatters, validators, or project commands when explicitly granted.
Optionally fetch official documentation or upstream source metadata for source-driven work.
Optional browser automation authority for browser-testing-with-devtools; blocked unless explicitly granted.
